Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

  require multiple sequence alignments. A FASTA suffix alone does not prove the
  sequences are aligned.

from zipfile import ZipFile
from collections import Counter
from statistics import mean, median
AA=set('ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY')

def fasta(txt):
 d={}; k=None
 for line in txt.splitlines():
  if line.startswith('>'): k=line[1:].split()[0]; d[k]=''
  elif k: d[k]+=line.strip().upper()
 return d

def vals(zp, mode):
 out=[]; desc=[]; chars=Counter()
 with ZipFile(zp) as z:
  for n in sorted(x for x in z.namelist() if x.endswith('.faa.mafft')):
   d=fasta(z.read(n).decode())
   lens={len(s) for s in d.values()}
   if len(lens)"'!=1: raise ValueError((n,lens))
   L=lens.pop(); pi=0
   for col in zip(*d.values()):
    chars.update(col)
    if mode=='"'strict': c=Counter(x for x in col if x in AA)
    elif mode=='gapstate': c=Counter(col)
    elif mode=='nongap_any': c=Counter(x for x in col if x not in '-?X')
    if sum(v>=2 for v in c.values())>=2: pi+=1
   out.append(100*pi/L)
   desc.append((n,len(d),L,pi,100*pi/L))
 return out,desc,chars

def ustat(x,y):
 tagged=[(v,0) for v in x]+[(v,1) for v in y]
 tagged.sort()
 rank_sum=0; i=0
 while i<len(tagged):
  j=i+1
  while j<len(tagged) and tagged[j][0]==tagged[i][0]: j+=1
  avg_rank=((i+1)+j)/2
  rank_sum += avg_rank*sum(g==0 for _,g in tagged[i:j])
  i=j
 return rank_sum-len(x)*(len(x)+1)/2
for mode in ['strict','nongap_any','gapstate']:
 a,ad,ac=vals('inputs/scogs_animals.zip',mode)
 f,fd,fc=vals('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip',mode)
 u=ustat(a,f)
 print('\\n',mode,'n',len(a),len(f),'U1',u,'U2',len(a)*len(f)-u)
 print('animal mean med range',mean(a),median(a),(min(a),max(a)))
 print('fungal mean med range',mean(f),median(f),(min(f),max(f)))
 print('seq count dist A',Counter(x[1] for x in ad),'F',Counter(x[1] for x in fd))
 print('chars A',ac,'F',fc)
PY"

from zipfile import ZipFile
from collections import Counter
AA=set('ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY')
def fasta(t):
 d={};k=None
 for l in t.splitlines():
  if l.startswith('>'):k=l[1:].split()[0];d[k]=''
  else:d[k]+=l.strip().upper()
 return d
def read(zp):
 out={}
 with ZipFile(zp) as z:
  for n in z.namelist():
   if not n.endswith('.mafft'):continue
   d=fasta(z.read(n).decode());L=len(next(iter(d.values())))
   pi=sum(sum(v>=2 for v in Counter(x for x in col if x in AA).values())>=2 for col in zip(*d.values()))
   out[n.removesuffix('.mafft')]=(len(d),pi,L,100*pi/L)
 return out
def U(x,y):
 q=sorted([(v,0)for v in x]+[(v,1)for v in y]);rs=0;i=0
 while i<len(q):
  j=i+1
  while j<len(q) and q[j][0]==q[i][0]:j+=1
  rs+=(i+1+j)/2*sum(g==0 for _,g in q[i:j]);i=j
 return rs-len(x)*(len(x)+1)/2
A=read('inputs/scogs_animals.zip');F=read('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip')
scopes={
'all':(list(A),list(F)),
'intersection':(sorted(A.keys()&F.keys()),sorted(A.keys()&F.keys())),
'four_taxa_each':([k for k,v in A.items() if v[0]==4],[k for k,v in F.items() if v[0]==4]),
'paired_both_four':([k for k in A.keys()&F.keys() if A[k][0]==F[k][0]==4],[k for k in A.keys()&F.keys() if A[k][0]==F[k][0]==4]),
'atleast2':([k for k,v in A.items() if v[0]>=2],[k for k,v in F.items() if v[0]>=2]),
}
for scope,(ak,fk) in scopes.items():
 print('\\n'+scope,len(ak),len(fk))
 for label,fun in [('exact',lambda x:x),('AMAS_prop3',lambda x:round(x/100,3)),('pct3',lambda x:round(x,3)),('pct2',lambda x:round(x,2)),('pct1',lambda x:round(x,1))]:
  x=[fun(A[k][3]) for k in ak];y=[fun(F[k][3]) for k in fk]
  u=U(x,y)
  print(label,'U1',u,'minU',min(u,len(x)*len(y)-u))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
read_group <- function(zipfile) {
  members <- unzip(zipfile, list=TRUE)"'$Name
  members <- members[grepl("'"\\\\.faa\\\\.mafft"'$", members)]
  vals <- numeric(length(members))
  ntaxa <- integer(length(members))
  for (i in seq_along(members)) {
    con <- unz(zipfile, members[i], open="r")
    lines <- readLines(con, warn=FALSE)
    close(con)
    headers <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
    ntaxa[i] <- length(headers)
    ends <- c(headers[-1]-1L, length(lines))
    seqs <- mapply(function(a,b) paste0(lines[(a+1L):b], collapse=""), headers, ends, USE.NAMES=FALSE)
    stopifnot(length(unique(nchar(seqs))) == 1L)
    mat <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(seqs, "", fixed=TRUE))
    valid <- c("A","C","D","E","F","G","H","I","K","L","M","N","P","Q","R","S","T","V","W","Y")
    informative <- apply(mat, 2, function(col) sum(table(factor(col[col %in% valid], levels=valid)) >= 2L) >= 2L)
    vals[i] <- 100 * sum(informative) / ncol(mat)
  }
  list(values=vals, ntaxa=ntaxa, members=members)
}
a <- read_group("inputs/scogs_animals.zip")
f <- read_group("inputs/scogs_fungi.zip")
result <- wilcox.test(a$values, f$values, alternative="two.sided", exact=FALSE, correct=TRUE)
cat("n:", length(a$values), length(f$values), "'"\\n\")
cat(\"taxa animal:\", paste(names(table(a"'$ntaxa)), table(a$ntaxa), collapse=", "), "'"\\n\")
cat(\"taxa fungi:\", paste(names(table(f"'$ntaxa)), table(f$ntaxa), collapse=", "), "'"\\n\")
cat(\"R statistic:\", format(result"'$statistic, scientific=FALSE), "'"\\n\")
cat(\"rank-derived U:\", sum(rank(c(a"'$values,f$values))[seq_along(a$values)]) - length(a$values)*(length(a$values)+1)/2, "'"\\n\")
cat(\"p-value:\", format(result"'$p.value, digits=16), "'"\\n\")
RS"
